dh_perenolde.accept_text:
The Lord's Hall, at the heart of the ring. You've done the work that makes this possible and I'd rather you knew it: without the fence's ledger and the magister's postings I'd have sent you in to kill a squatter.

Alterac sold the Alliance to the Horde and his father signed it. The Alliance dissolved the kingdom and left the family their titles, because titles cost nothing. This is what fifteen years of carrying a title and no country does to a man.

Durnholde Keep is south-east of Tarren Mill, off the east road. You know the archway.

dh_yvaine.accept_text: Durnholde Keep, south-east of Tarren Mill. Her tower is the west one, off the ring. One door, no other way out, which cuts both ways.

dg_morgrin.accept_text: Dun Garok, the dwarven fort cut into the ridge at the south end of the valley. Past the Great Hall, at the vault door.

az_kobolds.turn_in_text: All of them, and I got as far as the second landing without stopping. That's further than I've managed since midsummer.
az_kobolds.accept_text:
In through the adit in the western rock, and mind the standing water - it's deeper than the light makes it look and it does not drain anywhere.

That should clear the upper galleries. They'll be back. They're always back. I'd settle for walking my own mine without a torch in one hand and an axe in the other.

az_prospectors.accept_text:
Below the causeway. You'll hear the chain before you see the lamps - they sound the depth every ten paces and log it.

Alterac sold the pass to the Horde in the Second War and the Alliance dissolved the kingdom for it. The lords scattered into these hills with nothing. This is what nothing looks like when it finds a silver seam it used to own.

az_silver.accept_text:
Cut it off the Face and smelt it - my furnace, or any forge in the valley, I don't care whose.

Bars. Silver, mind. I've had three men bring me tin this season with a straight face, and tin out of a mine called Azurelode is a special sort of insult.
az_silver.turn_in_text:
All of them, and all of them silver.

You'd be amazed how rarely that sentence gets said down here.

dh_revenants.turn_in_text:
Lordaeron livery under the rot on all of them. I thought so.

They held this keep, they lost it, and they have been underneath everyone who's held it since.
